# cloudflare_zero_trust_cws_domain_acl (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cloudflare_zero_trust_cws_domain_acl" "example_zero_trust_cws_domain_acl" {
  account_id = "xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx"
  default_action = "ALLOW"
  entries = [{
    action = "ALLOW"
    domain = "x"
  }]
  name = "x"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_id` (String) Cloudflare account ID (32-character hexadecimal string)
- `default_action` (String) Default action when no entry matches
Available values: "ALLOW", "BLOCK".
- `entries` (Attributes Set) Domain entries for this ACL. Each domain must appear at most once. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--entries))
- `name` (String) Name of the domain ACL

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) Server-assigned UUID
- `updated_at` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--entries"></a>
### Nested Schema for `entries`

Required:

- `action` (String) Per-domain decision overriding the parent ACL's default_action
Available values: "ALLOW", "BLOCK".
- `domain` (String) Hostname or domain pattern, capped at 255 UTF-8 bytes

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
$ terraform import cloudflare_zero_trust_cws_domain_acl.example '<account_id>/<domain_acl_id>'
```
